**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of VPS37A and SNF8 in ESCRT function and MVB biogenesis could reveal common therapeutic targets for both MONDO:0013962 and neurodevelopmental disorder plus optic atrophy. Strategies aimed at restoring ESCRT pathway function or mitigating the downstream consequences of MVB defects might offer a unified treatment approach.
